one_liner: Coda has a free, broad REST API (v1) with personal API tokens, and an official hosted MCP server at coda.io/apis/mcp.
auth_notes: The REST API is documented around personal API tokens (Bearer). OAuth2 with PKCE is documented only for the MCP, and only with an mcp:all scope. The OAuth2 evidence for Packs covers authenticating Packs to third-party services, not a general OAuth app flow for the Coda REST API. The rollout.com guide describes an OAuth integration flow for Coda, but it is third-party and unverified. So API_KEY is primary.
access_notes: The API is free in free and paid workspaces. Tokens are generated in account settings. Rate limits are the same on all plans.
blocker_notes: None. Free-plan MCP use is limited to a small "free taste" quota, but the REST API is not limited this way.
